notes: North is up. Printed names: CURRAN, DALTON AVENUE, SARAH, SAND (Sand Alley, see 22-6L; 1904 Shaw Alley), DOVE (1904 Oehler Alley), PRESIDENT PL., HARRIET ST. / HARRIET STREET, LOUISA STREET, ESPANOLA ... STREET, FIRMAN (north of Clark) and ALLEY FIRMAN (south of Clark), FREEMAN AVENUE, CLARK, GEST and W. COURT (printed east of Freeman), PENNOCK ALLEY, CEDAR ALLEY, CARR, FILLMORE ST., MELVIN, LAUREL AL., PEKIN ALLEY, VOGT; Tucker Alley is printed ALLEY here (TUCKER on 22-6L); 9th and 8th are printed STREET here (W. NINTH, W. EIGHTH on 22-6L); OEHLER is printed on 22-6L (OEHLER'S SUBDIVISION here is a subdivision label). No bracketed old names. North of Hopkins east of Dalton is outside the plate. Harriet is in three legs: x ~2959 (30') Hopkins-Clark, x ~2662 Clark-Gest, x ~2165-2187 (50') Gest-8th and on; the legs meet Clark and Gest as offset T pairs. Oehler, Richmond and 9th jog at Harriet; Richmond also jogs at Carr; Clark and Gest jog at Freeman; all recorded as west-leg/east-leg T pairs. Sarah Alley (10' west of Harriet, 15' east, printed ALLEY east of Louisa as in 1904) runs from Dalton to a 10' N-S alley printed only ALLEY (x ~4739, Hopkins to Sarah) and ends there; Firman starts at Sarah. An unnamed 15' alley runs east from Freeman at y ~1351. Dove runs from Sand Alley to Harriet. Court ends at x ~2999 east of Harriet. Espanola runs from Harriet to Freeman; the unnamed alley from Dalton to Harriet (y ~3085) is almost on its line. Melvin and Laurel Alley enter 8th from the south; Carr and Harriet continue south of 8th. Only a ~300 px strip east of Freeman is mapped (scale, key and plate 4 beyond). Water pipes are solid lines, sewers dashed, and the trolley on Freeman/Clark/8th is the black-white line; none were used as street lines. Freeman slants from x ~5191 at Hopkins to ~5234 at 8th. Gutter overlap with 22-6L: Curran/Hopkins, Dalton/Hopkins, Dalton/Sarah, Sand/Sarah, Dalton/Clark, Sand/Clark, Sand/Dove, Dalton/Oehler, Sand/Oehler, Dalton/Gest, Vogt/West Court, Vogt/Richmond.
